finalText:
Root cause: Redis died. Timeline:

**02:14:07** — Redis connection lost (ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379). Cache layer degraded, all requests hit store directly.

**02:14:08 to 02:31:26** — Store gets hammered, can't keep up. Every request times out after 5s. Request queues back up across all workers. Reconnect attempts fail 13 times (every ~2min).

**02:31:44** — Worker-2 heap out of memory. Queue had hit 568 depth (max 500), sitting requests consumed all available JS memory.

**02:31:45** — Worker-2 crashed (code 134 = OOM kill), supervisor couldn't restart it. API became unresponsive, entire process group terminated.

**Fix** — Restore Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379. Once cache returns, store won't get slammed and queues drain. Also consider: lower the 5s timeout, cap queue depth to shed load earlier instead of OOMing, add circuit breaker to drop requests instead of queueing forever.
